detaileddescription.para: With required literals, the call is a SIMD search for them. Without literals, the automaton of the program finds the next matching line. With neither, the call returns offset unchanged.

briefdescription.para: Compiles one or more pattern texts into a Pattern.

detaileddescription.para: A pattern is a literal text, or a regex when isRegex is true. Several texts give an alternation. A pattern that is not a regex, and has one text, is kept as a literal, so no regex is built for it.

parameterdescription.para: The pattern texts. Each must be non-empty, and must not hold a newline. The views are read during the call only: create copies the text it keeps.
True when the texts are regular expressions.
True to ignore case.
True to match only a whole line.
True to match only whole words.
